description: This Java source file defines the PhonePermissionRequestActivity class, which manages the user interface flow for requesting runtime permissions (specifically read external storage) from the user on an Android device. It handles permission approval/denial, reacts to permission request results, and navigates back to the main activity with appropriate flags based on user choices and whether it was triggered by an external service.

classes.name: PhonePermissionRequestActivity
classes.description: An Activity that presents a rationale screen to the user for granting storage permissions, handles user responses, and navigates back to the main activity, optionally communicating whether it was invoked due to a request from a wearable device.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, checks existing permissions, and sets the content view.

methods.name: onClickApprovePermissionRequest
methods.description: Triggered when the user approves the permission request; initiates the system permission request dialog.

methods.name: onClickDenyPermissionRequest
methods.description: Triggered when the user denies the permission request; proceeds to start the main activity without requesting permission.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the permission request, logging the outcome and proceeding to the main activity.

methods.name: startMainActivity
methods.description: Launches the MainPhoneActivity, passing along an extra if this activity was started by a service requesting permission handling from wear.
